## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-a01745e6)

## Summary

rev43 finding 9 audit of ~25 dead-writer persistence families. Lane decision per family in `docs/reviews/rev44-staged.md`: **6 writers wired** across 3 record-entry surfaces, the rest documented staged (no honest producer today). All findings verified on this branch — several "live" audit claims were wrong and are corrected in the doc.

**Wired — `OperatingPresetRecordDialog`** (measurement page プリセットを記録 card): registers operator-declared presets (`save_preset`) and confirmed applied states (`save_applied_state` via `record_applied_preset_state`). Consumers that already read these rows: `HealthCheckDialog` preset combos, `CadProjectActivityService` `operating_preset_created`/`operating_preset_applied` events.

**Wired — treatment source-asset file entry**: `TreatmentDefinitionDialog` external source kinds (メーカー資料/測定データ/文献) now require a picked 出典ファイル; bytes retained via `save_source_asset`, digest lands in `source_sha256`. Consumer: `_check_managed_source_asset` + managed-asset backup. Calibration-file pattern verbatim.

**Wired — `InstallationRecordDialog`** (interventions panel 機材・設置を記録): records entity→equipment bindings (`save_binding`), installation contexts (`save_context`) and installation datums (`save_datum`). Consumers: `cad_evidence_register`, `cad_prediction_capability`, `overview_readiness` install gating, `installation_output_authority` datum resolution.

Fail-closed: `_head` pin at open, provenance required (blank 出典名 refuses), datum refuses identical X/Y walls, treatment external kinds refuse without a file. All user-facing text JA.

**Staged (documented only):** colorimetry, photometric, lighting, site, signal_path (consumer exists but graph authoring is an epic), validation_corpus, visual_qa, tactile, data_source (all, incl. `save_decision` — correction), gain_structure (all — correction), layout profile+topology (correction), measurement_pose (both — correction), multifidelity (all — correction), equipment_instance, field-evidence, commissioning, amplifier impedance/limit/freq-resolved (capability+load already live), evidence-reconciliation, library-upgrade, analysis-study, expansion cost-record/single-speaker, preset measurement-binding.
